name: 动作相位化接地验收：支撑、速度与阴影视觉线索分离
core_value: 先判定姿态属于静止承重、动态过渡还是腾空，再检查可见支点与重心/速度方向；接触阴影只作为空间知觉线索，不能替代物理支撑证明。
method_steps: 标记相位：准备/承重、推蹬、腾空、落地承重；结果姿态不得冒充起始姿态。
静止或低动量姿态检查重心投影与可见支撑区域；动态姿态额外检查重心运动方向、速度与下一支点，禁止只套静态支持多边形。
单独核对脚/手接触和光源一致性；接触阴影只证明观看者更容易感到贴地，不证明真实受力、摩擦或动作因果。

freshness.theory_layer: primary research and original technical work rechecked 2026-10-25

reproduction.result: identity/outfit and coarse anatomy consistent; panel 1 has visible support, panel 2 is a readable airborne transition, panel 3 has one-foot load acceptance. Panel 1 and 3 pose contrast is modest; no continuous motion or force measurement.

evidence.basis: independent animation/biomechanics and perception sources support the phase distinction and the shadow limitation

reproduction.basis: one static sample only; no video continuity, repeatability or target-model run

decision_reason: Evidence supports retaining the candidate, but joint visual reproduction and human votes are absent. 证据不足，今日不入库。
overlap: V1.3.0 already checks support and center of gravity; this candidate adds phase/momentum limits and explicitly demotes contact shadow from proof to perceptual cue.
